SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7972
Section 1, Special Branch Sd/phl
REPORT
Date June 27, 1937

Subject N. V. Stenin

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by J Boyne C S I

With reference to the endorsement of D.C. (Special
Branch) on the attached crime diary ( Central 1387/37), enqui-
ries show that Nicolas Vassilievitch STENIN, is a Russian who
was born on 14-2-1898 in Perm district, Russia. A former soldier
of the "White" Russian army in Siberia, he is reported to have
left the U.S.S.R. for Manchuria in 1923. In October, 1930 he
arrived in Shanghai and has since been residing in this city.
Here he was unable to secure any fixed employment and was prac-
tically destitute.
He did not come to the notice of this office in con-
nection with the activities of various political groups of local
Russian emigres.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

（批：26/6）

D.C. ( Special Branch)

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 28 JUNE 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 7972
特务科 第1组 Sd/phl
报告
日期：1937年6月27日

事由：N. V. Stenin（斯捷宁）

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）撰写，经J Boyne C S I转呈

参照附后犯罪日记（Central 1387/37）上特区副督察（D.C. (Special Branch)）的批注，经查，尼古拉·瓦西里耶维奇·斯捷宁（Nicolas Vassilievitch STENIN）系俄罗斯人，1898年2月14日出生于俄罗斯彼尔姆地区。据报他曾是西伯利亚“白”俄军队的一名士兵，于1923年离开苏联前往满洲。1930年10月抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。在此期间，他未能获得任何固定工作，实际上处于赤贫状态。
该员并未因当地俄国流亡者各政治团体的活动而引起本处注意。

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
副督察（D.S.I.）

（批注：6月26日）

HOOLIGANISM OF A RUSSIAN WHITEGUARDIST

At 7.20 a.m. yesterday Nicolas STENIN, a destitute Russian
Whiteguardist broke a window glass of the local office of the
INTOURIST, 640 Szechuen Road, where photographs and an illustrated
map of the Trans-Siberian route were displayed. He then kicked at
the window and by doing so cut his leg.
A constable on duty in the vicinity immediately arrested the
hooligan and took him to station. The broken window was insured for
$ 225. The Insurance Co replaced the broken glass.

一名俄国白卫分子的流氓行径

昨日上午7时20分，一名身无分文的俄国白卫分子尼古拉·斯捷宁（Nicolas STENIN）砸碎了四川路640号“苏联国家旅行社”（INTOURIST）本地办事处的橱窗玻璃，该处陈列有照片及西伯利亚铁路路线示意图。随后他用脚踢向窗户，因而割伤了腿部。
附近执勤的一名巡捕立即逮捕了这名滋事者，并将其带往警局。破碎的窗户投保金额为225美元。保险公司已更换了破损的玻璃。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Thursday, June 24, 1937

f.s. 1 Prokofiev

White Russian Hits
Intourist Window;
Value Set At $200

Nicolas V. Stenin, 46, is one of
those Russian exiles residing in
Shanghai who can't resist throw-
ing stones at buildings which in
any manner are connected with
the Soviet Union, so when he
passed the USSR Intourist Travel
Agency located in the Navy
Y.M.C.A. building at 640 Szechuen
Road at 7:20 o'clock this morning
it was only natural that he break
a window. A Chinese police con-
stable was on hand, however, and
took Stenin into custody.

Detective Sub-Inspector Ovsian-
nikoff has been put in charge of
the case, his duty being to find
what the motive was and where
the gain was to come in for Mr.
Stenin. The window is valued at
$200, Mr. A. Seregin, manager of
the company, stated this morning.
The accused, unemployed occa-
sional resident of the Salvation
Army home, is reported to be ill
and this probably soured his dis-
position considerably.

S.
b. h 25/6.

《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1937年6月24日，星期四

f.s. 1 普罗科菲耶夫

白俄撞击
苏联国际旅行社
橱窗；
损失估定200美元

尼古拉·V·斯捷宁，46岁，是居住在上海的俄国流亡者之一，这类人总是忍不住向以任何方式与苏联有关联的建筑物投掷石块，因此，当他今早7点20分经过位于四川路640号海军青年会大楼内的苏联国际旅行社（USSR Intourist Travel Agency）时，砸碎一扇窗户也就不足为奇了。然而，一名华捕当时在场，并将斯捷宁拘留。

副探长奥夫相尼科夫（Ovsianikoff）已负责此案，其职责是查明斯捷宁先生的动机及其企图从中获取何种利益。该公司经理A·谢列金（A. Seregin）先生今晨表示，窗户价值200美元。被告是一名失业者，偶尔居住在救世军收容所，据报患病，这可能使他的性情变得相当乖戾。

S.
b. h 6月25日。
JR

CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, JUNE 25, 1937

Brick Hurled
At Intourist
Office Here

Russian Vents Anti-
Soviet Spleen By
Glass-Breaking

WILL CONFRONT
COURT TODAY

Stenin Causes Damage
Worth About $200
At Red Agency

Nicolas V. Stenin, Russian, age 46,
stood at the corner of Szechuen
and Hongkong Roads yesterday and
gave expression to his hatred of the
U.S.S.R. by throwing a brick
through a plate glass window of
Intourist, official Soviet travel
agency.
The window was worth about
$200 and it is doubtful whether that
amount of money can be collected
from Nicolas. A regular customer
at the Salvation Army Hostel on
Amoy Road, he had only a few
cents in his pocket when robbed.
When he hurled the brick, a
Chinese police constable was stand-
ing only a few yards away. Stenin,
according to the officer, made no
effort to get away and submitted
peacefully to arrest.
The man was taken to the
Central Police Station and turned
over to Detective Sub-Inspector
Ovsannikoff. Questioned, the
fellow is stated to have declared
that he was slightly intoxicated at
the time. He added that when he
passed the Intourist office, he
couldn't resist the temptation to
break the window.
He will be brought before the
First Magistrate District Court this
morning charged with causing
malicious damage.

（批：bsl. Prokofiev. bfb）
（批：S·R）

《大美晚报》（CHINA PRESS），1937年6月25日，星期五

砖块掷向
本地苏联
国际旅行社
办事处

俄国人通过
砸玻璃发泄
反苏怒火

今日将
出庭受审

斯捷宁造成
红色机构
约200美元损失

俄国人尼古拉·V·斯捷宁，46岁，昨日站在四川路与香港路路口，通过向苏联官方旅行机构“苏联国际旅行社”（Intourist）的一块平板玻璃窗投掷砖块，表达其对苏联的仇恨。
该窗户价值约200美元，能否从尼古拉处追回这笔钱尚存疑问。他是厦门路救世军招待所的常客，被抢劫时口袋里只有几分钱。
当他投掷砖块时，一名华捕就站在几码之外。据该警员称，斯捷宁未试图逃跑，而是顺从地接受逮捕。
该男子被带至中央捕房，并移交给副探长奥夫桑尼科夫（Ovsannikoff）。经讯问，据说此人声称当时略有醉意。他补充说，当他经过苏联国际旅行社办事处时，无法抗拒砸碎窗户的诱惑。
他将于今天上午被提解至第一特区法院，被控恶意破坏财产罪。

（批注：bsl. 普罗科菲耶夫. bfb）
（批注：S·R）

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, JUNE 25, 1937

RUSSIAN HELD FOR
BREAKING WINDOW

“White” Alleged To Be
Demented; Intourist
Window Valued $200

An allegedly slightly demented unemployed “White” Russian was arrested early yesterday morning by a Chinese constable, on Szechuen Road, near Hongkong Road, after having broken the large window glass of Messrs. Intourist, the Soviet Travel Agency in the Navy Y.M.C.A. building.

The accused, Nicolai Stenin, 46-year-old unemployed Russian, was taken into custody by the constable at 7.20 a.m. immediately after he broke the large window, valued at $200. He was immediately taken to the Central Police Station and there upon being questioned gave several different versions of how he came to break the window.

Apparently not one of those “White” Russians who make it a habit to stone the Soviet Consulate in order to show their disapproval of the government Stenin is believed to be slightly demented. He gave several different versions of the occurence, one of them being that he was chased by two men and accidentally ran into and broke the glass. He also stated that he accidentally kicked the window. Detectives believe the man is slightly demented and will charge him with mischief in the First District Court this morning.

《上海泰晤士报》，1937年6月25日，星期五

俄国人因
砸窗被捕

“白俄”被指
精神失常；苏联国际
旅行社窗户估值200美元

一名据称略有精神失常的失业“白”俄，于昨日清晨在四川路近香港路处，在砸碎位于海军青年会大楼内苏联旅行机构“苏联国际旅行社”（Messrs. Intourist）的大块橱窗玻璃后，被一名华捕逮捕。

被告尼古拉·斯捷宁（Nicolai Stenin），46岁，失业俄国人，于上午7时20分在砸碎价值200美元的大块窗户后立即被该巡捕拘留。他随即被带至中央捕房，在接受讯问时，对于如何砸碎窗户一事给出了几种不同的说法。

斯捷宁显然不属于那些习惯向苏联领事馆投掷石块以示对政府不满的“白”俄之列，人们认为他略有精神失常。他对事件经过给出了几种不同的版本，其中一种说法是他被两名男子追赶，意外撞上并撞碎了玻璃。他还声称自己是不小心踢到了窗户。侦探们认为此人略有精神失常，将于今天上午在第一特区法院以滋扰罪对他提出指控。

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be commented on by investigating officer).

At 7.40a.m. on June 24th, C.P.C. 2967 brought to the station a Russian named Nicolas V. Stenin, 46 years of age, single, unemployed, N.F.A., whom he arrested outside 640 Szechuen Road for breaking a pane of glass in a window of the local branch of "Intourist" State Tourist Coy. of U.S.S.R., 640 Szechuen Road. C.P.C. 2967 reported to the station that at about 7.20a.m. on the same date, he noticed the accused when the latter threw his body against a pane of glass in the window of the local branch of "Intourist" Soviet Travel Agency, 640 Szechuen Road and hit the glass with his left shoulder, and broke the same. When the man was brought to the Station and questioned, he appeared to be excited and suffering from some mental disease. In view of the above, he was sent to the General Hospital where on being examined by Dr. Chambers, he was found to be suffering from acute psychosis, Confusional state and incised wound of the right leg. On return to the station, the accused was questioned by the undersigned regarding the offence but he could not explain satisfactory his intention in committing the said offence. He stated that being afraid of someone always chasing him in the streets of Shanghai with intent to kill, he decided to force the Police to arrest and lock him for some offence and thereby give him protection from the unknown enemy.

With this aim in his mind, the accused broke the pane of glass in the window of Intourist Travel Agency as stated above.

备注
（任何突出或特殊的特征需由调查警官评论）。

1937年6月24日上午7时40分，华捕2967号将一名名为尼古拉·V·斯捷宁（Nicolas V. Stenin）的俄国人带到警局，该员46岁，单身，失业，无固定住址（N.F.A.），因在四川路640号外砸碎苏联国家旅游公司“苏联国际旅行社”本地办事处（四川路640号）的一扇窗户玻璃而被捕。华捕2967号向警局报告称，同日约上午7时20分，他注意到被告用左肩撞向四川路640号“苏联国际旅行社”苏联旅行机构本地办事处的橱窗玻璃，并将玻璃撞碎。当该男子被带到警局并接受讯问时，他显得情绪激动，并患有某种精神疾病。鉴于上述情况，他被送往广慈医院，经钱伯斯医生（Dr. Chambers）检查，发现他患有急性精神病、意识混乱状态以及右腿切割伤。回到警局后，被告就上述罪行接受了下署人的讯问，但他无法对其实施所述罪行的意图做出令人满意的解释。他声称，由于害怕有人一直在上海街头追逐他并意图杀害他，他决定迫使警方以某种罪名逮捕并监禁他，从而保护他免受未知敌人的伤害。

怀着这一目的，被告如上所述砸碎了苏联国际旅行社办事处的窗户玻璃。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
From careful inquiries made it does not appear that the accused purposely attacked the Soviet State Organisation for committing his offence. There is no doubt that the man is crazy and needs medical attention.
As this offence was committed by a white Russian against the Soviet State Organisation and therefore is considered by Manager of the Intourist as a political offence, the accused is charged and will appear before the S.S.D. Court on June 5th.
The J-tourist of State Tourist Coy. of U.S.S.R. is a commercial organisation and in view of the above, the accused is charged with Mischief Cont. to Art. 354 of C.C.C.
The S.S.D. Court will be informed that the accused is suffering from mental disease and application will be made for his admission to Mental Hospital in Minghong.
The glass is insured but details of insurance is at present unknown.

经仔细查询，被告似乎并非故意攻击苏联国家组织以实施其罪行。毫无疑问，此人精神失常，需要医疗护理。
由于此罪行是一名白俄针对苏联国家组织实施的，因此被苏联国际旅行社经理视为政治罪行，被告已被控告，并将于6月5日出庭受审于S.S.D.法院。（注：原文日期6月5日与前文6月24日案发时间矛盾，依原文译出）
苏联国家旅游公司的“J-tourist”（原文如此，应为Intourist笔误）是一家商业组织，鉴于上述情况，被告被控违反《中华民国刑法》第354条之恶意破坏财产罪。
将告知S.S.D.法院被告患有精神疾病，并将申请将其送入明宏（Minghong，音译）精神病院。
玻璃已投保，但保险细节目前不详。

Tsang Kyung Sung.
Kompo
C.D.C. 208.
Central Stn.
24-6-37

Tsang Kyung Sung, aged 43 years, native of Kompo, N/public
ricsha coolie, residing at 654 Tsepon Road, states as follows:-
At about 7.30a.m. 24-6-37, whilst parking my ricsha on
Szechuen Road near Hankong Road, I saw a Russian walking in
southerly direction and appearing to be intoxicated. When nearing
the premises at 640 Szechuen Road I observed his left shoulder
knocking against the show window of the said premises which
resulted in breaking the window glass. Shortly afterwards the
Russian fell to the ground and on the arrival of Police he was
taken to the station.
Sgd:- Tsang Kyung Sung.

Tsang Kyung Sung（张景松，音译）。

中央捕房。
1937年6月24日

Tsang Kyung Sung（张景松，音译），43岁，籍贯Kompo（金浦，音译），无业，人力车夫，居住于芝罘路654号，陈述如下：-
1937年6月24日上午7时30分左右，当我在四川路近香港路处停放人力车时，我看见一名俄国人向南行走，看似醉酒。当靠近四川路640号的房屋时，我观察到他的左肩撞上了该房屋的展示窗，导致窗户玻璃破碎。不久后，该俄国人倒在地上，警察到达后将他带往警局。
签名：- Tsang Kyung Sung（张景松，音译）。
